Asset type: original square, text-free album-cover background for an internal duohertz electronic rhythm-game candidate.

It should evoke layered mineral color and springtime motion, without resembling a literal flower bouquet.
Style/medium: polished contemporary editorial electronic album illustration, tactile translucent layers, clean shapes, restrained luminous detail, readable as a tiny music thumbnail.
Composition/framing: exact square composition; petal layers occupy upper and middle portions, with a calm deep dusk-blue lower third reserved for a separate title overlay.
